text: [dry, indignant, telling a friend] The self-checkout machine thinks I'm a CRIMINAL.
[wistful] All I wanted was ONE banana.
[annoyed] It's the banana. You just SAW it.
[deadpan, judging himself] I apologized. To a MACHINE.
[humiliated] A sixteen-year-old came over to type the SECRET code.
[flat disbelief] It was one, two, three, four.
[humiliated] And the whole line watched me like I tried to steal a banana.
[resigned, dry] Paid. Twenty-five cents. Most expensive banana of my LIFE.
[dry, a little hopeful] Next week, I went to a REAL cashier.
[nervous, apologetic, quick] Sorry! Sorry. It's a banana.
[exploding, shouting] I KNOW it's the banana!
Unexpected item in the bagging area.
Please place the item in the bagging area.
Unexpected item in the bagging area.
[bored, flat, chewing gum] It's the banana.
[flat, deadpan robot imitation] Unexpected item in the bagging area.
